title: Privacy: an erase that neither the cloud nor the device copy took was kept only in memory, and a reload brought the record back
evidence: packages/health-core/src/record-session-erase.ts eraseSession: when the flush fails and the failure mirror did not land (save mode failed, status not-saved, cloud tier), the session puts back its pre-erase copy, clearedFor and saveWarning, and answers { success: false } with no reason. Before, the failed mirror write was swallowed (record-session.ts persist catch) while the page showed the erased record (web: own-end with 'Cloud sync failed - your latest changes are still on this device'; iPhone: EraseText.notSent 'Your record is erased on this iPhone'). The pending marker stays set: it lifts only the pre-erase copy into a pre-erase cloud. Steps before the write are not undone: chat tombstones and, on the web, the reminders teardown (S59). Words for this case: S58. Checks: packages/health-core/src/record-session.erase-mirror.test.ts, widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store-erase-mirror.test.ts, ios/engine/cloud.test.ts. US-11 AC3b, AC7; US-16 AC2a
